name: Ranger · Knight style E (Hooded Pokémon)
description: Lyra built on Style B (no black outline, every edge a dark shade of its own material; the sweeping cape, the lean, the slim build, the release burst) with her ranger's hood up and drawn a bit toward a Gen 4-5 Pokémon trainer sprite: a rounder, larger hooded head, a big bright teal eye with a white highlight, a friendly face framed by a silver fringe and lock, her long elf ear poking out through the hood, and clean 3-4 tone colour blocks (a bright green hood, mantle and cape over a cream linen tunic, a brown belt with a gold buckle, dark leather breeches and tan boots). The hood's pointed tail and the cape ripple in her breathing idle, trail back on her bobbing walk and are flung back by the shot. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the cheek (the string and arrow run behind her face, the elbow out behind her hood), holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.
